title: Communion letters held in the Archives of the Impossible

tellings.quote: four or 5 thousand of them are now at Rice University in a in an archive called the Archives of the Impossible, founded by Jeff Kriel.

plain: After the writer Whitley Strieber published Communion, his book about his own encounters with strange beings, readers sent him huge numbers of letters about their own experiences, and he says four or five thousand of them now sit at Rice University in Houston, Texas. Strieber tells it first-hand. He says they are held in a collection called the Archives of the Impossible, founded by a Rice scholar named Jeff Kripal, which would mean thousands of ordinary people's accounts are kept for study.
